data.name: MaxResults.Description
data.value: Specifies the maximum number of results returned for each ContextRelay search.

data.name: OutputDirectory.Description
data.value: Specifies the relative output directory used for generated handoff files.

data.name: EnableChatPreview.Description
data.value: Enables preview chat features such as /ask and Copilot chat integration.

data.name: EnableGraphDebugLogging.Description
data.value: Enables verbose debug logging for Microsoft Graph requests.

data.name: EnableWorkIqDebugLogging.Description
data.value: Enables verbose debug logging for Work IQ requests.

data.name: AllowLocalFileContextForWorkIq.DisplayName
data.value: Allow local file context for Work IQ

data.name: AllowLocalFileContextForWorkIq.Description
data.value: Allows /workiq #file prompts to send bounded local file text to Work IQ. Keep disabled if local source files must not leave this machine.

data.name: ClientId.Description
data.value: Specifies the Microsoft Entra application client ID used for sign-in.

data.name: TenantId.Description
data.value: Specifies the tenant ID or 'organizations' when using multi-tenant sign-in.

data.name: CloudEnvironment.Description
data.value: Selects the Microsoft cloud environment used by ContextRelay.

data.name: CustomGraphEndpoint.Description
data.value: Overrides the Microsoft Graph endpoint when a custom cloud configuration is required.

data.name: CustomAuthEndpoint.Description
data.value: Overrides the Microsoft identity authority endpoint when a custom cloud configuration is required.

data.name: CacheTtlSeconds.Description
data.value: Specifies how long cached search results remain valid.

data.name: CacheMaxEntries.Description
data.value: Specifies the maximum number of cached search result entries.

data.name: PersistWorkspaceState.Description
data.value: Persists workspace-specific cache and state between sessions.

data.name: TeamsEnabled.Description
data.value: Enables Microsoft Teams message search integration.

data.name: ConnectorsEnabled.Description
data.value: Enables Microsoft 365 connector content search integration.

data.name: PlannerEnabled.Description
data.value: Enables Microsoft Planner task search integration.

data.name: TodoEnabled.Description
data.value: Enables Microsoft To Do task search integration.

data.name: ChatMaxAttachedFiles.Description
data.value: Specifies the maximum number of files that can be attached to each chat request. Use 0 to disable file attachments.

data.name: ChatAttachActiveEditor.Description
data.value: Automatically attaches the saved active editor file to each chat request when it is eligible.

data.name: ChatStreamResponses.Description
data.value: Displays chat response content incrementally while it is being received.

data.name: UiLanguage.Description
data.value: Choose Auto to follow the Visual Studio display language, or pick English or Japanese explicitly.
